title: Address autocomplete at checkout
summary: Help people enter an Indian address quickly, and stop paying for a lookup on every keystroke.
context: Malleshwaram Mart's delivery fails too often because of bad addresses. Indian addresses lean on landmarks, and spellings vary: '4th Cross, near Ganesha temple'. The team wants suggestions as people type, and it pays a map provider per request.
Most orders come from a few thousand buildings, and many shoppers have ordered before. Many shop on a slow connection on a low-end phone.
must_handle: Suggestions feel immediate on a slow phone.
The paid lookup is called as rarely as possible.
A suggestion that arrives late never overwrites a newer one.
A person can always go on without choosing a suggestion.
Keyboard and screen reader users can use the list.
show_in_answer: What happens in the browser on each keystroke.
What is cached, where, and for how long.
How a typed address that matches nothing is treated.
